name: 44001 · Amherst, OH
findings: ZIP 44001 (Amherst) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44001 (Amherst) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44001 (Amherst) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44001 (Amherst) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
